hero.title: Get paid, pay out, and keep the books right.
hero.lede: Customers pay from a link or the invoice you sent. You pay suppliers and staff in runs. Every payment lands in the books by itself.

jobs.title: Money held in business wallets

connectsTitle: Connected to the rest of the business

connects.text: Online payments become receipts against the right invoices.
Payments, fees and wallets post to the ledger.
Supplier bills are paid in runs from what you owe.
Payroll remittances are paid from the same place.
Deposits for bookings are taken online.

faq.q: Can customers pay an invoice online?
faq.a: Yes. They pay from the invoice's shared page. When the payment is confirmed, the receipt is posted against the invoice.

faq.q: Could a supplier be paid twice by mistake?
faq.a: No. A payout is never sent twice, and a supplier's bank details can only be changed with an approval.

faq.q: Do payments show in the books?
faq.a: Yes. Wallets are accounts in the ledger, deposits to a customer's virtual account become receipts, and fees post to bank charges.
